headline: Fresh Fighting Shifts Along Six Fronts
war_summary: The latest figures show the contest narrowing but not quieting. Weathered Expanse remains the chief furnace, with 59 strategic-base events in 24 hours, three in the latest two-hour window, and heavy casualty rates rising on both sides; Spirit Watch and Frostmarch account for much of the activity. Farranac Coast has newly entered the ledger with two fresh events at Transient Valley, while Nevish Line has recorded two more at Tomb Father. Marban Hollow retains 30 daily events, though none arrived in the last two hours and its recent six-hour tally has cooled. Olavis Wake likewise stands at 30 events for the day, with eight in six hours but no new action in the latest window. Kuura Strand remains divided among three Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral base, yet its last two hours are empty after 19 daily events. Linn Mercy and Gutter also show no immediate movement, despite substantial earlier turnover. The present picture is therefore one of intense, concentrated pressure at a handful of fronts, with several formerly active sectors temporarily becalmed.
